integrity: All claims rely on an analytic spectral-projector decomposition and a positive-semidefinite kernel analysis valid for all positive part sizes. An embedded exact-rational checker tests nine finite graphs; these tests are corroborative, not substitutes for proof. No independent expert audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for unweighted adjacency continuous-time Cesaro walks on once-subdivided complete bipartite graphs; no weighted, arbitrary-subdivision, normalized-Hamiltonian, instantaneous-mixing or convergence-rate assertion is made. The general Schur-projector method and the path endpoints are previously known. Broader equivalent published theory may exist.
title: Quantum average mixing on subdivided complete bipartite graphs
